protocol: Fixed offline CPU TCN experiment on seven previously examined DFL fixtures. Seven outer leave-one-match-out models; no outer-driven early stopping, epoch selection, scaling or hyperparameter tuning. Fit normalization on training fixtures only. Input-only 298-feature sequence plus missingness indicators, sampled at 5 Hz within each half. Four two-convolution residual blocks, bidirectional context; 30-step halo on each side. Dead BCE uses frame weights; conditional-home BCE uses capped possession weights. Auxiliary next-state boundary supervision is training-only. Draw training match and clean/moderate/severe regime uniformly, and choose noisy seed uniformly; contextual and absorbed references are evaluation-only. Checkpoint each completed epoch and retain the final fixed epoch, not the best test epoch. Decode native-25-Hz probabilities with existing 40/40/8 costs and unchanged combined ownership-event evidence. Prespecified standalone-emission, 50/50 joint-probability blend and owner-only blend ablations; primary is joint blend. No competition inputs or labels, no automatic deployment promotion. Repeated seven-match architecture research and one training seed limit inference.
